A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CLAP and contain readable methods, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Although v2 lacks extractable text, visual inspection supports a reliable comparison of the complete documents.

before.justification: v2 reports original detection experiments, component ablations, SemanticKITTI segmentation, repeated-run statistics, and transfer experiments on ONCE.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds detection results using 100% of the NuScenes and Waymo fine-tuning data.

M1.justification: The joint encoders, differentiable rendering, curvature sampling, EM prototype training, swapping prediction loss, and Gram regularization are retained. The new no_grad implementation explanation does not establish a change to the underlying procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions cover NuScenes and Waymo detection, SemanticKITTI segmentation, and NuScenes-to-ONCE detection transfer. The added full-data fine-tuning experiments change sample counts within existing datasets and tasks.

E2.justification: The original detection comparisons retain random initialization, ALSO, OCC-MAE, SLidR, PPKT, and UniPAD. Segmentation and transfer comparator sets are also retained. New Table 6 reuses random initialization and UniPAD without replacing the original comparisons.

E3.justification: Appendix B.4 adds fine-tuning with 100% of NuScenes and Waymo training data, reporting NuScenes mAP/NDS and Waymo Level-2 mAP/mAPH. These supplement the retained few-shot protocols; existing splits, model configurations, and convergence-based controls remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix B.4 extends examination of label availability to full-data fine-tuning. Visual case-study evidence is reduced: v3 Figures 4 and 5 each omit one scene from the corresponding three-scene curvature and prototype visualizations in v2. The component ablation and transfer analysis remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report fixed seeds for main experiments and five NuScenes fine-tuning repetitions with identical means and standard deviations for random initialization, UniPAD, and CLAP. Table 6 follows fixed-seed reporting without introducing additional uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: New Table 6 reports CLAP versus random initialization under full-data fine-tuning: NuScenes mAP 65.11 versus 64.57 and NDS 68.38 versus 67.61; Waymo Level-2 mAP 69.49 versus 69.00 and mAPH 68.04 versus 67.57. Earlier numerical results are retained. B.4 reports an average gain of 0.55, although these differences average 0.5675. Section 3.3 also newly asserts less than 1% computational and memory overhead.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, rendering equations, curvature construction, and prototype objectives are retained without new assumptions, derivations, or proofs. Equation 5 repairs its interpolation argument to match the fused feature already specified in v2's prose; this is a notation correction.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same joint-pretraining contribution, curvature and prototype components, claim of up to 100% more performance improvement, and potential scaling claim. Additional full-data evidence does not redefine these core claims.

C2.justification: Section 3.3 newly attributes negligible curvature-estimation overhead to its no_grad implementation and avoidance of storing the calculation. Existing qualifications about noisy curvature/prototype assignments and untested pretraining-data scaling remain. The social-impact discussion is relocated into an Ethics Statement.

D1.justification: v3 adds the no_grad implementation detail, a repository link for promised code/models, and an identifiable MMDetection3D reference for the pretrained image backbone previously cited with an unresolved placeholder. Existing hyperparameters, hardware, learning rate, and training epochs are retained; the PDFs do not establish an actual code release.

R1.justification: Related work adds fusion segmentation and tracking citations to Wu et al. (2024) and Liu et al. (2024). References also resolve previously unidentified appendix sources for SemanticKITTI, ONCE, Cylinder3D, and MMDetection3D. Positioning relative to UniPAD and SwAV remains substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: Most prose and the main narrative are retained, with localized wording and terminology edits. Prototype discussion moves from the appendix to Section 4.4, social impacts move to the Ethics Statement, and acknowledgments, a reproducibility statement, and an LLM-editing disclosure are added.

P2.justification: The document is comprehensively reformatted from two-column pages and a separately formatted supplement into a unified single-column ICLR layout. Figure 1 is redrawn, Figure 3 gains annotations, Figure 4 loses a scene and enlarged views, and the shortened prototype visualization moves into the main text. Tables are resized and relocated, and Table 6 is added.

improvement.justification: The full-data experiments modestly strengthen evidence beyond few-shot settings, while repaired appendix citations and added implementation/access information improve traceability. Benefits are limited by fixed-seed reporting, the small arithmetic inconsistency in B.4, and reduced visual case-study detail. These constitute an incremental improvement to an otherwise scientifically stable paper.
